newsitem.title: CHINA: China media mourns Deng Xiaoping's demise.
newsitem.headline: China media mourns Deng Xiaoping's demise.

text.p: China's state media on Thursday mourned the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping at 92, with all major newspapers devoting the entire front page to his passing and radio and television programming interrupted.
Major newspapers splashed a huge black and white picture of Deng covering more than one-quarter of the front page and devoted the first two pages to news about his death in Beijing late on Wednesday.
Newspapers printed their usual red mastheads in black ink on Thursday. Chinese traditionally wear red when celebrating.
State radio broadcasters read excerpts of a book by Deng's daughter Deng Rong entitled "My Father, Deng Xiaoping" throughout the hour between news bulletins devoted to Deng's passing.
State television broadcast the movie "Liberating Yunnan", which featured a young Deng fighting the Nationalists and capturing the southwestern province.
